_meta.description: Default U-values (W/(m2.K)) for opaque walls, floors and roofs by construction/insulation period, climate zone group (H1/H2/H3) and heating type (electric joule vs others), per the 3CL-DPE 2021 lookup tables used when insulation characteristics are unknown. Also carries the uninsulated defaults (U_nu) and simplified window U defaults.
_meta.source: Annexe 1 (méthode 3CL-DPE 2021) de l'arrêté du 31 mars 2021 modifié, version consolidée rt-re-batiment.developpement-durable.gouv.fr : Umur_tab §3.2.1.1 (p.13, table lue depuis le schéma), Umur_nu=Min(Umur0;2,5) §3.2.1, Upb_tab §3.2.2.1 (p.17), Upb0 §3.2.2.2 (p.20), Uph_tab §3.2.3.1 (p.21, variantes combles/terrasse), Uph0=2,5 §3.2.3. Fenêtres : valeurs simplifiées V1 dérivées des tables Uw §3.3.2 (voir notes).
_meta.notes: Periods follow the 3CL brackets ('<=74 ou inconnu', 75-77, 78-82, 83-88, 89-00, 01-05, 06-12, '>=13'). The 3CL rule 'Si année de construction <=74 alors année d'isolation = 75-77' is implemented in envelope.py. V1 simplification (documented): a single wall table per zone group H1/H2/H3 (zone letters a/b/c collapse onto their group). Window defaults are a V1 simplification: representative Uw per glazing type, mid-range of the official Uw tables (§3.3.2) across frame materials — the app's simplified journey does not ask for frame material; deviation documented in docs/deviations.md.

uninsulated_defaults.wall_u_nu_traditional_note: Mid-range of the official Umur0 table (annexe 1 §3.2.1, p.12) for traditional uninsulated walls (pierre 40-55 cm: 2.05-2.3, briques pleines >= 34 cm: <= 1.65) instead of the 2.5 cap that assumes the worst masonry. Value 2.0 from ADEME calibration iteration 3 (choice M-6) until 2026-11-27; since the v1.1 recalibration (docs/recalibration_v1.1.md, P2), 1.7 = implied U of the pre-1975 walls labelled insuffisante in the DPE of calibration sample v3 (2.0 x factor 0.847 fitted on the published wall losses, validation/report/quality_label_factors_v3.json), within the Umur0 range 1.5-2.5. Used by the app bridge for uninsulated walls of unknown material; the validation mapping keeps 2.0 x the M-14 factors.

ground_contact_ue.note: Official Ue values (W/(m2.K)) replacing Upb for floors on vide sanitaire or sous-sol non chauffé, annexe 1 §3.2.2 table p.18, row 2S/P = 5 (typical detached-house footprint/perimeter ratio). Columns are Upb values; linear interpolation in between. Applied as b = Ue/Upb clamped to [0.15, 1] (choice M-7, validation/mapping.py; reused by bridge.py). Also the default when the floor type is unknown — this keeps the Phase 3 ADEME calibration unchanged.

ground_contact_ue_terre_plein.note: Official Ue values (W/(m2.K)) for floors on terre-plein, annexe 1 §3.2.2 tables p.19, row 2S/P = 5. Two tables per construction period (avant 2001 / à partir de 2001). Same b = Ue/Upb treatment as ground_contact_ue.

floor_b_unheated_space.note: Forfait b for a floor over an unheated space (garage, cellier) : annexe 1 §3.1 b table p.10, UV,ue = 3 (garage/cellier maison individuelle), Aiu/Aue <= 1,00, parois du local non chauffé non isolées -> b = 0,95. The floor then keeps its Upb (no Ue substitution).

apartment_reconstruction.note: Conventions de reconstruction des appartements, calibrées sur la campagne ADEME appartements du 2026-07-11 (8 895 DPE « appartement individuel », comparaison poste à poste avec les colonnes deperditions_*) — analogues aux choix M-1/M-6 des maisons. wall_area_factor : la convention 1-2 façades d'un logement carré sous-estime les murs déperditifs réels (pignons, refends sur locaux non chauffés, façades multiples) d'un facteur ~1,85 ; unknown_position_*_b : espérance de déperdition plafond/plancher quand la position dans l'immeuble est inconnue (parts RDC / dernier étage / planchers sur parkings) ; thermal_bridge_surcharge : les ponts thermiques d'appartement (liaisons refends x façades, about de plancher) pèsent bien plus que le forfait maison de 8 %.

wall_b_common_circulation.note: Forfait b for an apartment wall facing an unheated common circulation : annexe 1 §3.1 b table p.10, UV,ue = 0 (circulation sans ouverture directe sur l'extérieur, p.9), parois du local non chauffé non isolées, Aiu/Aue 10-25 (couloir profond, configuration conventionnelle) -> b = 0,35. Used by bridge.py / mapping.py for the non-through apartment layout (D-18).

wall_insulated_by_period.note: Umur_tab. 'before_1948' and '1948_1974' rows equal the '<=74 ou inconnu' column (2,5) — in practice envelope.py maps pre-1975 construction to the 75-77 insulation row when the wall is insulated at an unknown date.

floor_insulated_by_period.note: Upb_tab (plancher bas donnant sur l'extérieur ou local non chauffé).

roof_insulated_by_period.note: Uph_tab, variante 'Combles'. La variante 'Terrasse' est encodée séparément.

window_defaults.note: V1 simplified representative Uw (W/(m2.K)) and solar factor Sw per glazing type, mid-range across frame materials of the official §3.3.2 Uw and §6.2.1 Sw tables (fenêtre battante). Simple vitrage: Ug=5,8 -> Uw bois/PVC ~4,6-5,4. Documented deviation.

umur0_by_material.source: Annexe 1 3CL-DPE 2021 consolidée, §3.2.1.2 « Calcul des Umur0 » (p.14-15) : coefficient de transmission thermique du mur non isolé par matériau et épaisseur (W/(m².K)). Umur_nu = Min(Umur0 ; 2,5) (§3.2.1.1). Lu le 2026-11-27.
umur0_by_material.note: Each entry lists [thickness_cm, Umur0] columns in increasing thickness; the first column stands for 'less than or equal'. A thickness between two columns takes the column just below it (simplification: the annexe does not state an interpolation rule on this page). Stone: 'murs constitués d'un seul matériau / inconnu' row. Timber frame: 'sans remplissage tout venant' row.
